name: Bjørn Arnesen
bio:
Bjørn's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. He was working as a boat builder, renowned for his meticulous craftsmanship with fiberglass, when a local racing team, short on staff, approached him. His natural talent for composite work was immediately apparent, and he quickly adapted his skills to the high-stakes world of racing. Over the years, Bjørn has honed his expertise, becoming a reliable and resourceful composite technician. He is known for his unwavering attention to detail and his ability to diagnose and repair even the most complex composite structures. His experience makes him a valuable asset, particularly when facing unexpected challenges during a race weekend.

Bjørn's approach to his role is characterized by a blend of traditional craftsmanship and modern techniques. He is not afraid to experiment with new materials and methods, but always remains grounded in his deep understanding of the fundamentals. He takes pride in his work, striving for perfection in every repair and modification. What sets Bjørn apart is his ability to remain calm and focused under pressure. He is a steadying presence in the garage, always ready to lend a hand or offer a word of encouragement. He's also a stickler for cleanliness and organization, believing that a tidy workspace leads to better results.

physical.description: Bjørn is a sturdy man of medium height, with a weathered face that hints at years spent working outdoors.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn wooden ruler in his pocket.
Insists on using a specific brand of sandpaper, regardless of availability.
Has a habit of humming Norwegian folk songs while working.
